subject: general
question: A 100-mm centre-punch could have a 10-mm diameter body and a 6-mm diameter point ground to an angle of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __90°****.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• A centre-punch__ is a tool used to create a small indentation in a workpiece.
 
• It helps mark the center of a point for drilling or other machining operations.
 
• The point of the punch is ground to an angle, which is typically 90° for general purposes.
 
• This angle allows for effective alignment and accurate drilling.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of punches:**
 
 
• Prick punch: Used for layout purposes; has a sharper angle (typically 30° to 60°).
 
• Centre punch: Used to mark the center for drilling; standard angle is 90°.
 
• Drift punch: Used to align holes in mating parts.
 
 
 
• **Safety Tips:**
 
 
• Always wear safety glasses while using punches to avoid injury from flying chips.
 
• Ensure the workpiece is securely clamped before marking or punching.
